messages:
Sam (Docs): Hi all — opened PR with migration guide + SDK snippet updates for quant-mode serving. Need to coordinate merge relative to the v1.4 cutoff. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/4332

Ravi (Eng): Thanks. Which APIs changed? Any deprecated calls referenced?

Sam (Docs): We replaced `client.serv.generate` with `client.text.generate` in examples and added a note about the `quant_mode` flag. Also added a migration checklist and a short troubleshooting section.

Elsa (Product): Important: this doc shows the new quantized latency/throughput numbers. We should not publish those publicly until we confirm benchmarks with infra. Suggest gating the page or using site `unpublished: true` until bench sign-off.

Tomas (Release): v1.4 docs cutoff is Tue 18:00 UTC. After that only hotfix docs. If the benchmarks aren't confirmed by Mon EOD, we'll have to push the merge post-cut.

Sam (Docs): CI preview is failing with broken link and code-snippet lint. build-bot says: "docs-preview: broken links: /guides/old-quant-reference and snippet-lint: code-block 3: unknown param 'modelId'"

build-bot: preview run started for PR #4332 — job id j-44211

Ravi (Eng): The old link should point to `/guides/quant-overview` now. I'll PR a one-line fix. For the snippet, we changed parameter `modelId` -> `model`. Easy replace.

Sam (Docs): Pushed link and snippet fixes. Also added frontmatter `supported_versions: ["1.4"]` and `unpublished: true` until product gives bench sign-off.

build-bot: preview j-44211 — linkcheck passed, snippet-lint passed, html build succeeded. Preview: https://docs-preview/internal/4332

Elsa (Product): Quick review: content looks good, but change `unpublished: true` to `draft: true` instead — draft pages are excluded from sitemap and search. Also remove the public latency table for now (keep internal table in front matter).

Sam (Docs): Switched to `draft: true` and moved latency numbers to `internal_metrics: true` in frontmatter. Updated PR.

Tomas (Release): Two actions before pre-cutoff merge: 1) Add `merge-on-slot` label and slot on release calendar, 2) ensure release-notes entry is internal-only and tagged for post-release public update.

Sam (Docs): Done — label added, calendar event scheduled Mon 11:00 UTC merge slot, release-notes set to internal-only and assigned to Elsa for later public wording.

Ravi (Eng): Code review: LGTM, only suggest a tiny wording tweak in the troubleshooting bullet about cache invalidation. Approving.

Elsa (Product): Approved. Leaving a comment about re-evaluating the public wording after infra benchmarks.

Sam (Docs): All approvals in place. CI preview green. Will *not* flip draft flag until Elsa signs off on bench numbers. Queue merge for Mon 11:00 UTC slot but will hold publish.

build-bot: PR #4332 — approvals=2, checks=passed, labels=[merge-on-slot, draft-ready]. Ready for scheduled merge.

Sam (Docs): Update: merged to main at 2024-11-11T11:00:02Z behind `draft: true`. Page is in repo but not shown on site. Leaving this thread open until Elsa confirms bench sign-off to remove draft and publicize.

Elsa (Product): Noted. I'll ping infra for final numbers and update here.

Tomas (Release): Marking merge completed on release checklist. Reminder: if we need to back out, create a revert PR and notify docs channel.

Ravi (Eng): Thanks everyone. Nice to keep site clean with draft flag.

Sam (Docs): Closing thread after bench sign-off.
